phrases.speak: Think Git and GitHub are the same thing? They're not!
phrases.show: Think Git and GitHub are the same thing? They're not!

phrases.speak: Imagine you're building a website. You write some code, change the design, and add new features.
phrases.show: Imagine you're building a website. You write some code, change the design, and add new features.

phrases.speak: Git keeps track of those changes, so you have a history of your project.
phrases.show: Git keeps track of those changes, so you have a history of your project.

phrases.speak: If something goes wrong, Git helps you find and recover an earlier version.
phrases.show: If something goes wrong, Git helps you find and recover an earlier version.

phrases.speak: GitHub is different. It's an online platform where you can store and share Git repositories.
phrases.show: GitHub is different. It's an online platform where you can store and share Git repositories.

phrases.speak: Use git push to send your commits to GitHub, and git pull to bring remote changes back.
phrases.show: Use git push to send your commits to GitHub, and git pull to bring remote changes back.

phrases.speak: With git clone, you can copy a repository onto another computer.
phrases.show: With git clone, you can copy a repository onto another computer.

phrases.speak: And git add and git commit let you stage and save a snapshot of your changes.
phrases.show: And git add and git commit let you stage and save a snapshot of your changes.

phrases.speak: So remember: Git tracks your project's history. GitHub hosts and shares repositories online.
phrases.show: So remember: Git tracks your project's history. GitHub hosts and shares repositories online.
